nodes.label: Day Assignment Formula
nodes.rationale: Day is computed at query time as ((p.id - 1) % 19) + 1, not stored in DB, to map 250 problems across 19 days deterministically without schema changes.

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition (Revision Selection)
nodes.rationale: Revision problems are selected via source[(day * 7) % source.length] to deterministically pick different problems each day, weighted toward Medium/Hard.
